ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (approx. 15%) primarily located on the median line and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments on both lobes; a central vertical dark band with irregular, jagged lateral edges; dark pigmentation framing the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with acute convergence of the lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with low-to-moderate frequency jagged peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge; increased amplitude of irregularities on the distal thirds.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, terminating in slightly tapered lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of circular, high-contrast tan/white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the right terminal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant cluster of sessile organisms (barnacles) on the right fluke tip; minor irregular pigmentation loss on the lower-left edge near the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation band features a distinctive 'jagged' or 'splashed' pixel distribution along its right lateral interface with the white lobe.
